title: Block plan v1
description: Extraction contract. Produced by extract() in ReadLaterCore, read by the app, the research gate and every future platform. Mirrors ReadLaterCore.BlockPlan exactly: a rename here is a schema version bump, not a refactor. Source of truth: read-later-research/spec/non-prose-classification.md. v1.1 additive keys: schema_version (alias of version) and extractor_version are optional, so v1.0 files still validate. New writers emit all three keys, so only validators updated to this file accept new output; a validator pinned to v1.0 rejects it.

version.description: Schema version, not the app version.

schema_version.description: Alias of version, the name new writers emit. Optional so v1.0 files validate.

extractor_version.description: Parser build that produced the plan. Optional so v1.0 files validate; missing means 0.

source.description: File name of the HTML the plan was built from.

source_sha256.description: Hex digest of the source HTML bytes.

validation_failures.description: Sentences that are not exact slices of their block text. Must be 0; the builder exits non-zero without writing otherwise.

offset.description: Character offset inside the block text.

reason.description: The signal that decided the kind: element name, class, or heuristic.

image_url.description: Image reference for image and figure blocks, as written in src (first srcset candidate when src is absent). Unresolved against any base; no loader reads it yet. Absent for every other kind.

alt.description: The alt text as written, for the caption well and accessibility. Absent when the element carried no alt.

children.description: Nested blocks, e.g. figure > img + figcaption.

spoken.description: Sentences to enqueue. Empty for skipped blocks.

lowConfidence.description: True when confidence < 0.8. Logged as telemetry.
